experiment_data.hypothesis: Evaluate GRPO v1b LoRA adapter (merge + evaluate.py) to get RE-F1/Evi-F1/AP for kill criteria comparison against SFT baseline
experiment_data.note: v1b 策略几乎未更新 (KL=8.3e-5)，eval 确认模型 ≈ SFT baseline：RE-F1 0.4264 vs 0.4337 (-1.7%)，Evi-F1 0.3593 vs 0.3652 (-1.6%)，AP 0.9540 vs 0.9529 (+0.1%)。差异在噪声范围内，符合 KL≈0 预期。v2 (10x LR + 4x batch) 才是真正的 GRPO 验证。

spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/autodl-tmp/prov_grounded_uie && PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 python -u evaluate.py --model_path ./outputs/grpo_v1b/merged --batch_size 8 --max_prompt_length 4096 --output_file ./outputs/grpo_v1b/eval_results.json"
